params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch removes all "TODO" tags from comments, which directly addresses the SonarQube warning about tracking "TODO" tags. The changes are limited to cleaning up comments by removing or rephrasing "TODO" notes without altering any code logic or variable names. There are no unrelated or unnecessary modifications to the code itself, only comment cleanup. This is a minimal and focused fix that resolves the warning with the least impact on unrelated code.

Score: 3
